creator: Yulin Luo, Chun-Kai Fan, Menghang Dong, Jiayu Shi, Mengdi Zhao, Bo-Wen Zhang, Cheng Chi, Jiaming Liu, Gaole Dai, Rongyu Zhang, Ruichuan An, Kun Wu, Zhengping Che, Shaoxuan Xie, Guocai Yao, Zhongxia Zhao, Pengwei Wang, Guang Liu, Zhongyuan Wang, Tiejun Huang, Shanghang Zhang
description: A comprehensive evaluation benchmark for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as embodied brains, spanning 14 capabilities, 25 tasks, and 6092 QA pairs across diverse embodiments and multi-view scenes.
name: RoboBench
publisher: Peking University, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, Fudan University, University of Science and Technology Beijing, Beijing Innovation Center of Humanoid Robotics
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: 20 professionally trained annotators conducted comprehensive quality inspections, validating linguistic clarity, answerability, and correctness. A majority-vote strategy was adopted: items that all models solve correctly were removed, whereas items all models fail to solve underwent manual review and correction.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Gemini generates structured annotations—task summaries, step-wise instructions with timestamps, and metadata—which are refined by human annotators. Each step is then mapped into function templates. Explicit instructions are rewritten into implicit ones using LLMs. Human annotators also label bounding boxes and relative positions.
rai:dataCollection: Data combine large-scale real-world robotic datasets (Fang et al., 2023; Collaboration et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024; Bu et al., 2025) with curated in-house collection.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Large-scale real-world robotic datasets (Fang et al., 2023; Collaboration et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2024c; Wu et al., 2024; Bu et al., 2025) and curated in-house collection, including single-arm, dual-arm, and mobile manipulation videos.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Physical data collection
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data workflows follow three stages: preprocessing, annotation with VLMs/detection models/human experts, and Q&A format generation. Frame sequences are extracted as standardized inputs, and all data are standardized into multiple-choice QA or structured formats.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as the cognitive core (embodied brain) for robotic manipulation across instruction comprehension, perception reasoning, generalized planning, affordance prediction, and failure analysis.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Gemini (for structured annotations), GPT (for generating functional properties and distractors), LLMs (for rewriting explicit instructions into implicit ones).
